[1/4] Plan the sealed browser build: JS port of the sim core, canvas UI, node parity tests, live app registry entry

impact_assessment.why: The AegeanWorks Live page serves fully static builds with no network; Orrery currently only runs as a Python process, so the studio site cannot host it in-page
impact_assessment.benefits: Orrery becomes playable on aegeanworks.github.io like the other live apps; parity tests keep the port honest against the Python core
impact_assessment.risks: contract: live build must never call fetch/XHR/WebSocket or load external URLs; JS core must reproduce leapfrog/1PN/Coulomb/merge/bounce bit-close; dependency: node only for optional parity tests (skipUnless); concurrency: none; state: appends live.json and docs/live in AegeanWorks
impact_assessment.mitigation: Port first, dump-then-compare parity tests against Python for all nine golden scenarios, validate_source + REUSE checks before any commit; no push without authorization
